settings.commits.label: Commits
settings.commits.body: How a session here commits its work in its own tree: each piece that passes its checks as it goes, each commit after your yes, or one commit when the work is done. It never makes, switches or pushes a branch, and your Accept lands only what is committed. Your convention, how a commit message is written, is quoted to each session as you wrote it. A repository's rule replaces its workspace's whole.
settings.commits.says.asYouGo: Each piece that passes its checks is committed as the work goes.
settings.commits.says.ask: Each commit waits for your yes before it is made.
settings.commits.says.atEnd: One commit is made when the work is done.
settings.commits.says.convention: Each session is told how a commit message is written: “{{convention}}”
settings.commits.saved.asYouGo: Work in {{name}} is now committed as it goes.
settings.commits.saved.ask: Each commit in {{name}} now waits for your yes.
settings.commits.saved.atEnd: Work in {{name}} is now committed once, when it is done.
settings.commits.cleared: {{name}} takes its commit rule from what stands above it again.
